translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhiyuan era the Prince of Yan was made crown prince, and talented scholars were selected for his staff. Xi was put in charge of literary affairs, concurrently headed central brewing and palace gatekeeping, and supervised construction of the crown prince's palace with sound regulations. The emperor was pleased, granted him gold and currency and stable horses, and gave him the name Shila.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授中議大夫、工部侍郎，行同知王府都總管府事。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Grand Master of Correct Counsel and vice minister of Works, acting associate director of the crown prince's chief steward's office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Grand Master of Correct Counsel and vice minister of Works, acting associate director of the crown prince's chief steward's office.

sentences.zh: 十九年春，皇太子從帝北幸。

translations.literal: In spring of the nineteenth year the crown prince followed the emperor on the northern progress.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the nineteenth year the crown prince accompanied the emperor on the northern progress.

sentences.zh: 時丞相阿合馬留守大都，專權貪恣，人厭苦之。

translations.literal: At that time Chief Councillor Ahmad remained at Daidu, monopolizing power and greedy and unrestrained; people were weary and suffering under him.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Ahmad remained at Daidu, monopolizing power in greed and arrogance until the people were weary of his rule.

sentences.zh: 益都千戶王著與高和尚等，因構變謀殺之。

translations.literal: Yidu chiliarch Wang Zhu and Gaoshanghe and others therefore plotted a disturbance to murder him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhu, a chiliarch of Yidu, joined Gaoshanghe and others in a plot to murder him.

sentences.zh: 三月十七日，觿宿衛宮中，西蕃僧二人至中書省，言今夕皇太子與國師來建佛事。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth day of the third month Xi was on guard in the palace; two Western Tibetan monks came to the Secretariat saying that this evening the crown prince and the imperial preceptor would come to perform Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth day of the third month Xi was on guard in the palace when two Tibetan monks came to the Secretariat and said the crown prince and the imperial preceptor would come that evening to perform Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 省中疑之，俾嘗出入東宮者雜識視之，觿等皆莫識也，乃作西蕃語詢二僧曰：「皇太子及國師今至何處？」

translations.literal: Those in the Secretariat were suspicious and had those who had gone in and out of the Eastern Palace mixed among them to look; Xi and the others all failed to recognize them, and therefore spoke in Western Tibetan to question the two monks: "Where have the crown prince and imperial preceptor arrived now?"
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was suspicious and had men who knew the Eastern Palace staff examine them. Xi and the others recognized none of them. Xi questioned the monks in Tibetan: "Where are the crown prince and the imperial preceptor now?"

sentences.zh: 二僧失色。

translations.literal: The two monks changed color.
translations.idiomatic: The two monks turned pale.

sentences.zh: 又以漢語詰之，倉皇莫能對，遂執二僧屬吏。

translations.literal: He again questioned them in Chinese; flustered they could not answer, and the two monks were seized and handed to officials.
translations.idiomatic: He questioned them again in Chinese. Flustered, they could not answer, and the two monks were seized and handed over to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 訊之皆不伏，觿恐有變，乃與尚書忙兀兒、張九思集衛士及官兵，各執弓矢以備。

translations.literal: Under interrogation none confessed; Xi feared a disturbance and therefore joined with Ministers Mangwuer and Zhang Jiusi to gather guards and government troops, each holding bow and arrows in readiness.
translations.idiomatic: Under interrogation they confessed nothing. Fearing a disturbance, Xi joined Ministers Mangwuer and Zhang Jiusi in gathering palace guards and government troops, all armed with bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 頃之，樞密副使張易亦領兵駐宮外。

translations.literal: Shortly after, Privy Council Vice Director Zhang Yi also led troops stationed outside the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Privy Council vice director Zhang Yi also led troops and encamped outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 觿問：「果何為？」

translations.literal: Xi asked: "What is really happening?"
translations.idiomatic: Xi asked, "What is really going on?"

sentences.zh: 易曰：「夜後當自見。」

translations.literal: Yi said: "After nightfall you will see for yourself."
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "You will see for yourself after nightfall."

sentences.zh: 觿固問，乃附耳語曰：「皇太子來誅阿合馬也。」

translations.literal: Xi pressed the question; Yi then whispered in his ear: "The crown prince has come to execute Ahmad."
translations.idiomatic: When Xi pressed him, Yi whispered in his ear, "The crown prince has come to kill Ahmad."

sentences.zh: 夜二鼓，忽聞人馬聲，遙見燭籠儀仗，將至宮門，其一人前呼啟關，觿謂九思曰：「他時殿下還宮，必以完澤、賽羊二人先，請得見二人，然後啟關。」

translations.literal: At the second watch of night suddenly the sound of men and horses was heard; from afar candle lanterns and ceremonial escort were seen approaching the palace gate; one man came forward calling to open the gate; Xi said to Jiusi: "When His Highness returns to the palace, Wanzhe and Saiyang must always come first—please see the two men, then open the gate."
translations.idiomatic: At the second watch he suddenly heard the sound of men and horses and saw candle lanterns and ceremonial escort approaching the palace gate. One man came forward calling for the gate to be opened. Xi told Jiusi, "When His Highness returns to the palace, Wanzhe and Saiyang always come first. Do not open the gate until you have seen them both."

sentences.zh: 觿呼二人不應，即語之曰：「皇太子平日未嘗行此門，今何來此也？」

translations.literal: Xi called for the two men but there was no answer; he then said to them: "His Highness the crown prince on ordinary days has never used this gate—why come here now?"
translations.idiomatic: Xi called for the two men, but there was no answer. He called out, "His Highness never uses this gate on ordinary days. Why come here now?"

sentences.zh: 賊計窮，趨南門。

translations.literal: The rebels' stratagem exhausted, they rushed for the south gate.
translations.idiomatic: Their stratagem exhausted, the rebels rushed for the south gate.

sentences.zh: 觿留張子政等守西門，亟走南門伺之。

translations.literal: Xi left Zhang Zizheng and others to guard the west gate and ran swiftly to the south gate to watch.
translations.idiomatic: Xi left Zhang Zizheng and others to guard the west gate and ran to the south gate to watch.

sentences.zh: 但聞傳呼省官姓名，燭影下遙見阿合馬及左丞郝禎已被殺。

translations.literal: He only heard the calling out of Secretariat officials' names; in the candlelight from afar he saw Ahmad and Left Vice Councillor Hao Zhen already killed.
translations.idiomatic: He heard only the calling of Secretariat officials' names. In the candlelight he saw from afar that Ahmad and left vice councillor Hao Zhen had already been killed.

sentences.zh: 觿乃與九思大呼曰：「此賊也！」

translations.literal: Xi then with Jiusi shouted loudly: "These are rebels!"
translations.idiomatic: Xi and Jiusi shouted together, "These are rebels!"

sentences.zh: 叱衛士急捕之，高和尚等皆潰去，惟王著就擒。

translations.literal: He ordered the guards to seize them swiftly; Gaoshanghe and others all scattered and fled, only Wang Zhu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the guards to seize them at once. Gaoshanghe and the others scattered and fled; only Wang Zhu was captured.

sentences.zh: 黎明，中丞也先帖木兒與觿等馳驛往上都，以其事聞。

translations.literal: At dawn Censor-in-chief Yesentiemur with Xi and others galloped by relay to Shangdu to report the affair.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn censor-in-chief Yesentiemur rode with Xi and others by relay to Shangdu to report what had happened.

sentences.zh: 帝以中外未安，當益嚴武備，遂勞使遣亟還。

translations.literal: The emperor, because within and without were not yet settled, should further tighten military readiness, therefore comforted the envoys and ordered them to return swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Because the realm was not yet settled within and without, the emperor said military readiness must be tightened further, comforted the envoys, and ordered them to return at once.

sentences.zh: 高和尚等尋皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Gaoshanghe and others soon all were executed after confession.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoshanghe and the others were soon all executed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，遷嘉議大夫，同知大都留守司事，兼少府監。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Grand Master of Advising Counsel, associate director of the Daidu garrison office, and concurrent director of the Imperial Household Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Grand Master of Advising Counsel, associate director of the Daidu garrison office, and concurrent director of the imperial household works.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷中奉大夫、河南等路宣慰使。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to Grand Master of Correct Service and pacification commissioner of Henan and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was transferred to Grand Master of Correct Service and pacification commissioner of Henan and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 卒，年五十三。

translations.literal: He died, age fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of fifty-three.

sentences.zh: ○張九思

translations.literal: Zhang Jiusi
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiusi

sentences.zh: 張九思，字子有，燕宛平人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiusi, styled Ziyou, was a native of Wanping in Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiusi, whose style name was Ziyou, was a native of Wanping in the Yan region.

sentences.zh: 父滋，薊州節度使。

translations.literal: His father Zi was military governor of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zi was military governor of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 至元二年，九思入備宿衛，裕皇居東宮，一見奇之，以父廕當補外，特留不遣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan Jiusi entered to stand ready in the palace guard; Prince Yu dwelt in the Eastern Palace and at one sight found him remarkable; by his father's privilege he should have been assigned outside, but he was specially kept and not sent away.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhiyuan era Jiusi entered the palace guard. Prince Yu, dwelling in the Eastern Palace, took an immediate liking to him. Though entitled by his father's privilege to an outside appointment, he was specially retained at court.

sentences.zh: 江南既平，宋庫藏金帛輸內府，而分授東宮者多，置都總管府以主之，九思以工部尚書兼府事。

translations.literal: Once Jiangnan was pacified, Song treasury gold and silks were delivered to the inner court, but much was allotted to the Eastern Palace; a chief steward's office was established to oversee it, and Jiusi as Minister of Works concurrently held office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiangnan was pacified, Song treasury gold and silks were delivered to the inner court, much of it allotted to the Eastern Palace. A chief steward's office was established to oversee these assets, and Jiusi served as minister of works with concurrent duties in that office.

sentences.zh: 十九年春，世祖巡幸上都，皇太子從，丞相阿合馬留守。

translations.literal: In spring of the nineteenth year the Founder made a progress to Shangdu, the crown prince followed, and Chief Councillor Ahmad remained on guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the nineteenth year Kublai progressed to Shangdu with the crown prince, while Chief Councillor Ahmad remained at Daidu.

sentences.zh: 妖僧高和尚、千戶王著等謀殺之，夜聚數百人為儀衛，稱太子，入健德門，直趨東宮，傳令啟關甚遽。

translations.literal: The sorcerer-monk Gaoshanghe, chiliarch Wang Zhu, and others plotted to murder him; by night they gathered several hundred men as ceremonial guard, called themselves the crown prince, entered Jiande Gate, went straight to the Eastern Palace, and transmitted orders to open the gate with great urgency.
translations.idiomatic: The sorcerer-monk Gaoshanghe, chiliarch Wang Zhu, and others plotted his murder. By night they gathered several hundred men as a ceremonial guard, claimed to be the crown prince, entered Jiande Gate, and rushed straight to the Eastern Palace, urgently demanding that the gate be opened.

sentences.zh: 九思適直宿宮中，命主者不得擅啟關，語在《高觿傳》。

translations.literal: Jiusi happened to be on overnight guard in the palace and ordered the gatekeepers not to open the gate on their own authority—the account is in the biography of Gao Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi happened to be on overnight guard in the palace and ordered the gatekeepers not to open the gate without authorization. The full account appears in the biography of Gao Xi.

sentences.zh: 賊知不可紿，循垣趨南門外，擊殺丞相阿合馬、左丞郝禎。

translations.literal: The rebels knew they could not be deceived, followed the wall to rush outside the south gate, and struck and killed Chief Councillor Ahmad and Left Vice Councillor Hao Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing they could not be deceived, the rebels followed the wall to the south gate, where they struck down Chief Councillor Ahmad and left vice councillor Hao Zhen.

sentences.zh: 時變起倉卒，且昏夜，眾莫知所為，九思審其詐，叱宿衛士並力擊賊，盡獲之。

translations.literal: The disturbance arose in haste and it was also dark night; the crowd did not know what to do; Jiusi judged their deception and ordered the overnight guards to strike the rebels together with full force, capturing them all.
translations.idiomatic: The disturbance broke out in haste on a dark night, and no one knew what to do. Jiusi saw through the deception, ordered the overnight guards to strike the rebels together, and captured them all.

sentences.zh: 賊之入也，矯太子命，徵兵樞密副使張易，易不加審，遽以兵與之。

translations.literal: When the rebels entered they forged the crown prince's order to summon troops from Privy Council Vice Director Zhang Yi; Yi did not examine it and hastily gave them troops.
translations.idiomatic: On entering, the rebels forged the crown prince's order to summon troops from privy council vice director Zhang Yi. Yi did not investigate and hastily gave them troops.

sentences.zh: 易既坐誅，而刑官复論以知情，將傳首四方。

translations.literal: Yi was already condemned and executed, but the judicial officers again argued he had known and planned to transmit his head to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was already executed, but the judicial officers argued that he had known of the plot and proposed sending his head to the four quarters as a warning.

sentences.zh: 九思啟太子曰：「張易應變不審，而授賊以兵，死復何辭！

translations.literal: Jiusi reported to the crown prince: "Zhang Yi did not examine the sudden change and gave the rebels troops—death leaves him nothing to say!
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi reported to the crown prince, "Zhang Yi failed to judge the emergency and gave the rebels troops. Death is his only answer for that.

sentences.zh: 若坐以與謀，則過矣，請免傳首。」

translations.literal: If he is convicted of joining the plot, that is excessive—I beg to exempt transmitting his head."
translations.idiomatic: But to convict him of joining the plot would be excessive. I beg that his head not be sent about the realm."

sentences.zh: 皇太子言於帝，遂從之。

translations.literal: The crown prince spoke to the emperor and it was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince spoke to the emperor, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 九思討賊時，右衛指揮使顏進在行，中流矢卒，怨家誣為賊黨，將籍其孥，九思力辯之，得不坐。

translations.literal: When Jiusi suppressed the rebels, Right Guard Commander Yan Jin was on the expedition, was struck by an arrow and died; an enemy slandered him as a rebel accomplice and planned to register his household for punishment; Jiusi argued forcefully and he was not convicted.
translations.idiomatic: During the suppression Right Guard commander Yan Jin was on the expedition, was struck by an arrow, and died. An enemy slandered him as a rebel accomplice and sought to punish his household. Jiusi argued forcefully on his behalf and the family was spared.

sentences.zh: ○王伯勝

translations.literal: Wang Bosheng
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bosheng

sentences.zh: 王伯勝，霸州文安人。

translations.literal: Wang Bosheng was a native of Wen'an in Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bosheng was a native of Wen'an in Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 兄伯順，給事內廷，為世祖所親幸，因以伯勝入見，命使宿衛。

translations.literal: His elder brother Boshun served in the inner court and was favored by the Founder; thereby Bosheng was brought in for audience and ordered to serve in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Boshun served in the inner court and was favored by Kublai, through whom Bosheng was presented at court and ordered into the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 時伯勝年十一，廣顙巨鼻，狀貌屹然，帝顧謂伯順曰：「此兒當勝卿，可名伯勝。」

translations.literal: At that time Bosheng was eleven, with broad forehead and huge nose, his appearance towering; the emperor turned and said to Boshun: "This boy should surpass you—he may be named Bosheng."
translations.idiomatic: Bosheng was then eleven, with a broad forehead and prominent nose and an imposing bearing. The emperor turned to Boshun and said, "This boy will surpass you. Let him be named Bosheng—'Surpassing Elder Brother.'"

sentences.zh: 帝嘗沃盥，水溫冷甚稱旨，問進水為誰，內侍李邦寧曰：「伯勝。」

translations.literal: The emperor once washed his face; the water's warmth and coolness greatly suited his intent; he asked who had brought the water; inner attendant Li Bangning said: "Bosheng."
translations.idiomatic: Once, when the emperor washed his face, the water's temperature pleased him exactly. Asked who had brought it, inner attendant Li Bangning said, "Bosheng."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此兒他日必知為政，達人情矣。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This boy another day will surely know how to govern and understand human feelings."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This boy will one day know how to govern and understand what moves men's hearts."

sentences.zh: 至元二十五年，從征乃顏，以功授朝列大夫、拱衛直都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Zhiyuan he followed the campaign against Nayan and for merit was appointed Grandee of the Court Assembly and commander of the Arch Guard Direct Command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan era he joined the campaign against Nayan and for his merit was appointed Grandee of the Court Assembly and commander of the Arch Guard direct command.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年，賜金虎符，進階嘉議大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen he was granted a gold tiger tally and advanced to Grand Master of Advising Counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yuanzhen era he received a gold tiger tally and was advanced to Grand Master of Advising Counsel.

sentences.zh: 成宗即位，復進通議大夫。

translations.literal: When Chengzong took the throne he was further advanced to Grand Master of Universal Counsel.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong ascended the throne he was further advanced to Grand Master of Universal Counsel.

sentences.zh: 初，拱衛直隸教坊，衛卒多市井無賴，竄名宿衛。

translations.literal: At first the Arch Guard was subordinate to the Music Bureau; guard soldiers were mostly market riffraff who slipped their names into palace guard rolls.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Arch Guard was subordinate to the Music Bureau, and many of its soldiers were market riffraff who had slipped their names onto the palace guard rolls.

sentences.zh: 及伯勝為指揮使，乃盡募良家子易之。

translations.literal: When Bosheng became commander he then recruited only sons of good families to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: When Bosheng became commander he replaced them entirely with recruits from respectable families.

sentences.zh: 五年，扈從上都，天久雨，夜聞城西北有聲如戰鼙然。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he accompanied the progress at Shangdu; heaven rained long; at night from the northwest of the city came a sound like battle drums.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, while accompanying the court at Shangdu during prolonged rains, he heard at night from the northwest of the city a sound like war drums.

sentences.zh: 伯勝率衛卒百人出視之，乃大水暴至，立具畚鍤，集土石、氈罽以塞門，分決壕隍以洩其勢，至旦始定，而民弗知。

translations.literal: Bosheng led a hundred guard soldiers out to look; it was a great flood arriving suddenly; he immediately prepared baskets and spades, gathered earth, stone, felt, and rugs to block the gates, divided and opened moats and ditches to release its force; by dawn it was settled, yet the people did not know.
translations.idiomatic: Bosheng led a hundred guards out to investigate and found a sudden flood. He at once gathered baskets and spades, piled earth, stone, felt, and rugs to block the gates, and opened ditches and moats to divert the water. By dawn the danger had passed, and the people never knew what he had done.

sentences.zh: 丞相完澤以聞，帝嘉之。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Wanzhe reported it and the emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Wanzhe reported it to the emperor, who praised him.

sentences.zh: 九年，以侍成宗疾，忤安西王，出為大寧路總管，伯順亦出為梁王傅。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because while attending Chengzong's illness he offended the Prince of Anxi, he was sent out as prefect of Daning Circuit; Boshun was also sent out as tutor to the Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, while attending Chengzong during his illness, he offended the Prince of Anxi and was sent out as prefect of Daning circuit. Boshun was sent out at the same time as tutor to the Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，召拜通奉大夫、也可扎魯花赤、刑部尚書。

translations.literal: When Wuzong took the throne he was summoned and appointed Grand Master of Correct Service, yeke darughachi, and Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzong ascended the throne he was recalled and appointed Grand Master of Correct Service, chief darughachi, and minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 至大二年，加右丞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhida he was made right vice councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhida era he was made right vice councillor.

sentences.zh: 明年，進銀青榮祿大夫、大都留守，兼少府監。

translations.literal: The next year he was advanced to Silver-Green Grandee of Glorious Emolument, Daidu garrison commander, and concurrent director of the Imperial Household Works.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was advanced to Silver-Green Grandee of Glorious Emolument and appointed Daidu garrison commander with concurrent duties as director of the imperial household works.

sentences.zh: 初，大都土城，歲必衣葦以御雨，日久土益堅，勞費益甚，伯勝奏罷之。

translations.literal: At first Daidu was an earthen wall; every year it had to be clothed in reeds against rain; as time passed the earth grew firmer and labor and expense grew ever greater; Bosheng memorialized to abolish this.
translations.idiomatic: Daidu had originally been an earthen wall that had to be thatched with reeds each year against the rain. As the earth hardened over time the labor and expense grew ever greater. Bosheng memorialized to abolish the practice.

sentences.zh: 仁宗立，正百官品秩，降授資德大夫，尋复升榮祿大夫，拜遼陽等處行中書省平章政事。

translations.literal: When Renzong was established he corrected official ranks; Bosheng was demoted to Grand Master of Assisting Virtue, soon again raised to Grand Master of Glorious Emolument, and appointed grand councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne and corrected official ranks, Bosheng was demoted to Grand Master of Assisting Virtue, then soon raised again to Grand Master of Glorious Emolument and appointed grand councillor of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遼陽省治懿州，州弊陋，民不知學。

translations.literal: The Liaoyang secretariat administered Yizhou; the prefecture was dilapidated and crude and the people did not know learning.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaoyang secretariat was based at Yizhou, a dilapidated prefecture where the people had no tradition of learning.

sentences.zh: 伯勝始至，為增郡學弟子員，擇賢師以教之。

translations.literal: When Bosheng first arrived he increased the county school's student quota and selected worthy teachers to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: When Bosheng first arrived he increased enrollment at the prefectural school and selected worthy teachers to instruct the students.

sentences.zh: 使客至，無所舍，皆館於民，民苦之，伯勝乃擇隙地為館厩，度閒田百頃，募民耕種，以廩餼之。

translations.literal: When envoys arrived there was nowhere to lodge and all were housed among the people, to the people's distress; Bosheng then chose vacant land for guest lodges and stables, surveyed a hundred qing of idle fields, recruited people to cultivate them, and used the granary provisions to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: When envoys arrived there was nowhere to lodge them, and they were quartered in private homes to the people's distress. Bosheng chose vacant land for guest lodges and stables, set aside a hundred qing of idle fields, had the people cultivate them, and used the harvest to supply the guests.

sentences.zh: 歲大旱，伯勝齋戒以禱，禱畢即雨，人謂之平章雨。

translations.literal: One year there was great drought; Bosheng fasted in purification to pray; when the prayer ended rain came at once; people called it the Grand Councillor's Rain.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of great drought he fasted and prayed, and rain fell as soon as the prayer ended. The people called it the Grand Councillor's Rain.

sentences.zh: 廷祐二年，召為大都留守，遼陽民狀其行事，言於中書，乞留伯勝，不報，民涕泣而去。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou he was summoned as Daidu garrison commander; the people of Liaoyang petitioned his conduct, spoke to the Secretariat, begged to retain Bosheng, received no reply, and departed weeping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Yanyou era he was summoned back as Daidu garrison commander. The people of Liaoyang petitioned the Secretariat to keep him, received no answer, and left weeping.

sentences.zh: 三年，特授銀青榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the third year he was specially granted Silver-Green Grandee of Glorious Emolument.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was specially granted the rank of Silver-Green Grandee of Glorious Emolument.

sentences.zh: 至治二年，賜金虎符，授武衛親軍都指揮使，兼大都屯田事，仍大都留守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizhi he was granted a gold tiger tally, appointed commander of the Martial Guard personal army, concurrently in charge of Daidu military colonies, and still Daidu garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhizhi era he received a gold tiger tally and was appointed commander of the Martial Guard personal army with concurrent charge of Daidu military colonies while retaining his post as Daidu garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 奉詔監修文武樓，創咸寧殿，建太廟。

translations.literal: By imperial order he supervised repair of the Civil and Military Tower, created the Xianning Hall, and built the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order he supervised repair of the Civil and Military Tower, built the Xianning Hall, and constructed the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年冬，以疾卒。

translations.literal: In winter of the third year of Taiding he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness in the winter of the third year of the Taiding era.

sentences.zh: 賜翊忠宣力保惠功臣、太保、金紫光祿大夫、上柱國，追封薊國公，諡忠敏。

translations.literal: He was granted the title Meritous Minister who Assists Loyalty, Proclaims Power, Preserves Kindness, and Protects Favor, Grand Guardian, Golden Purple Grandee of Splendid Blessings, and Upper Pillar of the State, posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Ji with posthumous name Zhongmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as a meritous minister who assisted loyalty, proclaimed power, preserved kindness, and protected favor, given the ranks of Grand Guardian, Golden Purple Grandee of Splendid Blessings, and Upper Pillar of the State, enfeoffed posthumously as Duke of Ji, and granted the temple name Zhongmin.

sentences.zh: 長子恪，初名安童，累官至兵部尚書，南台治書侍御史，僉宣徽院事。

translations.literal: His eldest son Ke, originally named Antong, rose through offices to Minister of War, investigating censor of the Southern Branch Censorate, and associate director of the Imperial Household Court.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Ke, originally named Antong, rose through the ranks to minister of war, investigating censor on the southern branch censorate, and associate director of the imperial household court.

sentences.zh: 次馬兒，以宣武將軍襲武衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: The second, Ma'er, as General of Proclaiming Martiality inherited command of the Martial Guard personal army.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Ma'er inherited the post of commander of the Martial Guard personal army with the rank of General of Proclaiming Martiality.

sentences.zh: 孫善果襲。

translations.literal: The grandson Shanguo inherited.
translations.idiomatic: The grandson Shanguo inherited the post in turn.

sentences.zh: 伯順官至大司徒。

translations.literal: Boshun reached office as Grand Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Boshun rose to the rank of Grand Minister of Education.
